non_claims: No checkpoint file, model weight, config or hyperparams file is present, downloaded, loaded or executed.
No PyTorch, torchaudio, SpeechBrain or HyperPyYAML module is imported or installed.
No audio signal, corpus payload, manifest or output WAV is read or written.
No SepFormer inference, separation, enhancement or scoring run is performed.
Recorded per-item rows are checked for arithmetic consistency only; that is provenance, not a reproduced result.
The synthetic envelope is protocol plumbing with no audio, model, quality, timing or release meaning.
No listening, device-timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, descriptor, registry, default, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
The upstream DNS4 2022 DNSMOS values are source-reported and are not local scores.
Whole-utterance processing is not streaming and no content delay, state or availability result is inferred.

protocol_envelope.mechanism_note: The unit_peak variant is a bounded synthetic gain control. It shows a level change with unchanged length; it is not SepFormer output and says nothing about model content or quality.

recorded_provenance.note: Aggregates are recomputed from recorded per-item rows with exact decimal arithmetic. This is provenance consistency, not a reproduced run, quality result or qualification.

reopening_conditions: Stage the exact e8c258546300102a240fa2595854d473cbfee49a six-file revision and record byte counts, SHA-256 and reviewed terms.
Provide the locked offline CPython 3.11.5 / torch 2.14.1 / SpeechBrain 1.0.3 runtime with wheel digests and deterministic one-thread policy.
Freeze a rights-cleared paired corpus with noisy/clean digests and output-use decisions.
Reproduce per-item inference offline with three byte-identical repeats.
Apply the Enhancement profile with identity/baseline controls, paired SI-SDR/STOI, clean preservation, peaks and adverse controls.
Measure alignment, memory, availability and target-device timing and run authorized listening only if claimed.
Open a separate OFF-by-default provider intake with independent exact-head review.
